system.description: This spell creates a globe of light 60' across. It is much brighter than a torch, but not as bright as full daylight. It will continue to glow forever, or until it is magically removed. It may be cast on an object, just as the first level light spell. If cast at a creature's eyes, the victim must make a saving throw vs. spells. If he fails the saving throw, the victim is blinded—permanently, or until the spell is dispelled. If he makes the saving throw, the globe will still appear, but will remain in the place it was cast, and the intended victim will suffer no ill effects. The reverse of this spell, continual darkness, creates a volume of complete darkness in a 30' radius.
